title: tc-line-items
description: Rows a model reads off a document, for a person to fix, total and confirm.

source.description: The document the rows came from – shown under the heading

streaming.description: Rows are still arriving: the grid is busy and Confirm waits

currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency of the amounts

locale.description: The locale for numbers and amounts, and for reading what's typed

taxRate.description: Tax as a fraction of the subtotal – 0.08 for 8 %; 0 hides the tax row

statedTotal.description: The total the document itself states; a different total is called out

threshold.description: Confidence below this (0–1) marks a row "Low confidence"

confirmLabel.description: The label of the button that hands the rows back

unitPrice.description: The price of one, in the document's currency

amount.description: The row's amount when the document states it; else quantity × unit price

category.description: A quiet line under the description – "Travel", "Lodging"

confidence.description: How sure the model was of the row, 0 to 1; below the threshold the row says "Low confidence"

uncertain.description: The cells the model wasn't sure of; each says "Check" until someone edits it

flag.description: A warning about the row, in words – "No receipt attached"

LineItemField.description: A cell a person can edit
